title: Umujyi wizeraga igihe
intro: Mu nkuru z’imbabazi z’Imana, hari umuryango wagize ihinduka rikomeye mu buryo rusange. Ugiye kuvumbura inkuru yabo—inkuru y’umuburo, kwihana, no guhosha ibintu bibatandukanya n’ibyago by’andi mahanga.
clues: Twari ubwoko bwatumweho intumwa, kandi twabanje kwirengagiza umuhamagaro wayo.
Igihe ibimenyetso by'igihano cyari cyegereje byagaragaraga neza, twabonye ukuri kw'umuburo we.
Twahindukiriye Umwami wacu twihannye by'ukuri, kandi ukwizera kwacu kwemerwa.
Igihano cyari cyaratanzwe kuri twe cyakuweho kubera ukwemera kwacu.
Inkuru yacu ivugwa nk'idasanzwe mu mijyi yizeye nyuma yo kubona igihano.
Twari ubwoko bw'umuhanuzi wamizwe n'ifi nini, nyamara twarakijijwe kurimbuka.
